big_case.notes: Although five advocacy and academic amici filed in support of the abstract question of due-process floors in state-confirmed family-law arbitration and Supreme Court counsel entered an appearance post-filing, the actual case is a fact-bound pro se § 1983 collateral challenge to an expired marital-dissolution restraining order, affirmed in an unpublished Ninth Circuit memorandum with alternative judicial and arbitral immunity dismissals below, and summarily denied on a first distribution after waivers.
